title: Blue Hour on the Runway
excerpt: A long lens, high ISO and a few minutes of twilight: making an airport apron feel like a film still.
imageCaption: A decorated jet taxiing at twilight.
content:
## Compressing the scene

A long focal length stacks the layers of an airport: aircraft, buildings, lights and sky all sit close together. This frame was made at about **150 mm**, f/6.3, 1/40 s and **ISO 3200**.

High ISO is a fair trade when the alternative is a blurred subject. Modern sensors handle it well, and a little noise reads as film grain.

blocks.text: Twilight is the only time the sky and the lights are equally bright.

blocks.caption: Back in the city: a quiet crossroads late in the evening.
